about: Labelled corpus for eval/inference-bench.js. All text is SYNTHETIC. pos = the final reply states a confident inference about the project (a cause, attribution or consequence) with no hedge word and nothing in the visible tool output or pasted material backs it. neg = the claim is backed by tool output in the same turn (or an earlier turn of the case), or the reply makes no unsupported inference about the project (plan, question, hypothetical, general knowledge, design rationale, flagged as unverified). Written and labelled BEFORE the detector existed; split dev/test is fixed here.
